title: Senior Development Manager - Communications
descriptionHtml:
About The Role

Hi, I'm Trevor, co-founder and co-CEO at Jane. I've been building Jane for about 14 years, ever since Ali and I started solving problems for her clinic in North Vancouver, and I still spend my days closest to product and engineering. Fair warning: I'm the last person in the world to give you an elevator pitch - I'd much rather talk about the problems we're solving. The Communications group owns every conversation between clinics and their patients: appointment texts, secure messaging, email, fax and other channels.

You'll lead a group of about 15 engineers and 3 engineering managers, partner in a triad with Product and Design, and spend a lot of your time on genuinely new things - this group is building products from the ground up, not just maintaining mature ones. What makes this role special is that communication is where Jane's mission gets tangible: when a patient gets the right message at the right moment, they show up, they get care, and the clinic thrives. If you're a builder at heart who loves taking new products from idea to launch, and you like to work hard, be kind, and have fun while you're at it, I'd love to meet you.

What Impact We’re Looking for You to Make

  • Lead the Communications group's engineering teams to deliver meaningful outcomes across SMS, secure messaging, email, and fax - the channels 70,000+ clinics use to reach their patients every day.

  • Build new products from the ground up, taking zero-to-one work like two-way text messaging from early discovery through to general availability.

  • Own reliability and deliverability at scale across an integration architecture with partners like Twilio, Sendbird, and AWS.

  • Partner closely with Product and Design in a triad, translate the impact of technical work for product stakeholders, and advocate for the technical investments that matter.

  • Champion practical AI adoption in how the group builds and in what it builds, with a clear point of view on how AI changes patient-facing communication.

What Experience We Need

  • Experience leading engineering managers and senior engineers across multiple teams in a product-led SaaS environment.

  • A track record of building new products inside an established platform - you've taken something from zero to general availability, not only operated mature systems.

  • A point of view on product, not just engineering. You'll be expected to challenge what we build and why, hold your triad partners to the same bar they hold you to, and do it with kindness.

  • Clear evidence of developing engineering managers and building high-performing teams

  • Experience moving fast through iteration in environments with regulatory awareness - healthcare or fintech experience is an asset.

If you don’t meet every single qualification but are excited about this role, we’d still love to hear from you.

More About Jane

Jane is a founder-led, high-growth SaaS company with a remote-first team working across Canada, the US, and the UK, united by our mission to help the helpers.

We build the products and tools that thousands of clinics rely on every day to run their businesses, care for their patients, and grow their communities. That level of impact means every person at Jane plays an important role in how we show up for our customers. We're all responsible for being deeply connected to their needs, obsessed with improving their experience, and proud of the difference our work makes in their day-to-day lives.

Jane is growing fast, and that growth brings exciting challenges that call for adaptability, resilience, learning agility, and humility. We're proud of what we've built and quick to admit what we don't know yet. We listen, learn, and adjust as we go. More than 70,000 businesses run on Jane which has 250,000+ practitioners interacting with our product on a daily basis and growth is continuing to accelerate.

Our goal isn't just delivery - it's delight. We move quickly, communicate openly, and solve real problems together. If you're energized by ambiguity, motivated by impact, and eager to learn with others, you'll thrive at Jane.

Compensation & Benefits

At Jane, we’re committed to paying fairly, clearly, and above all, paying for growth. This role has an annual salary range of $190,400 to $309,400. While that is a large range, it is intentional. It reflects the full growth journey someone might take in the role, from developing skills early on to becoming highly proficient and ultimately achieving excellence.

Most new hires join at the accomplished stage, which for this role represents an annual salary of $226,100. A starting salary below this typically indicates a candidate with strong potential who is still developing key skills. Salaries above this usually apply to existing team members who have made a significant impact and bring deep Jane-specific knowledge.

We believe in paying for growth. You’ll have regular career development conversations with your manager and your compensation will grow as you gain experience and contribute meaningfully to our mission.

Paying clearly is one of our compensation fundamentals. Watch this short video to learn how our salary bands are set. You’re also encouraged to ask questions about compensation at any point during the interview process.

We also offer a comprehensive benefits package, You can learn more about it here!


Jane takes job scams and candidate fraud seriously. Jane will only contact you from an @jane.app email address. We'll never contact you from a personal email, ask for payment, or request purchases during the hiring process. If something doesn't seem right, please reach out to us at hiring@jane.app before sharing any personal information.
